## About Our Consortium

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

The Ocular Microbiome Consortium brings together researchers, clinicians, and data scientists to investigate microbial communities on the eye.

We promote collaboration, reproducible research, and open data.

[About Us →](Consortium_members.qmd)

:::
